contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAE L SEP SEV PERT [AVG] COSII ; R/ FORTVN REDVC

A silver denarius of Septimius Severus dating to the period AD 193-211. Reverse shows Furtuna standing left, holding rudder and cornucopiae. Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAE L SEP SEV PERT [AVG] COSII. Reverse description: Fortuna left holding rudder and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: FORTVN REDVC. Dimensions: diameter: 17.1mm; weight: 1.78g. Die axis measurement: 12 o'clock
